subject: Frame opening: an aging Ashok dictates a new edict on a Deccan hill, and memory begins.
events: Flashbacks to boyhood and first blood
grounding_notes: The frame establishes the novel as memory carved into stone. The hill and the chisel are recurring symbols.
chapter_summary: An aging Ashok travels to a Deccan hill to carve a new edict, dictating from memory. The frame opens in memory-time, with flashbacks to boyhood, exile, and first blood.
